economic_baseline.rule: Do not change this baseline without an independent buyer, settled attributable payment, successful fulfillment, retrievable delivery evidence, and reconciliation.

existing_offer_candidates.commercial_role: First external end-to-end proof, not a margin claim
required_proof: canonical route and exact live offer/price mapping read back
settled live payment with correct attribution

existing_offer_candidates.commercial_role: Later bounded event-receipt pack after the probe and unit economics pass
required_proof: active canonical price and payment link match the offer ID
atomic quota decrement and concurrency/replay tests
measured payment fees, tax treatment and refunds as applicable
positive contribution margin above the configured floor

unit_economics.formula: contribution_nzd = collected_amount_nzd - applicable_tax_nzd - refunds_and_disputes_nzd - payment_processing_nzd - provider_and_compute_cost_nzd - delivery_and_storage_cost_nzd - attributable_support_cost_nzd
unit_economics.gate: Do not mark an offer economically qualified until the unit cost basis and minimum margin threshold are explicitly configured and measured. Null means unknown, never zero.

billing_contract.billable_unit: one unique accepted receipt for a valid authorized request
billing_contract.same_key_same_payload: return original receipt; no second charge or quota decrement
billing_contract.same_key_different_payload: reject with conflict; no side effects
billing_contract.invalid_or_unauthorized_request: reject; do not execute or bill
billing_contract.failed_execution: do not bill as successful delivery; preserve a failure receipt for diagnosis
billing_contract.receipt: stable ID, payload digest, version, status, timestamps, usage and cost references, and retrievable delivery evidence
billing_contract.raw_payload_storage: minimize; store only what the declared contract and privacy policy require

free_b2b_marketplace_contract.claim_quality: a listing or submission is not verified demand, availability, or revenue
free_b2b_marketplace_contract.commercial_boundary: charge for successful bounded execution only after real value, authorization, fulfillment and unit economics are proven

required_acceptance_gates.pass_when: Custom domain and provider host route, method, auth requirements, manifest and version match; HTTP status and deployed revision are recorded.
Canonical offer, Stripe product/price/link, amount, NZD currency, live mode, SKU metadata and webhook routing match exactly.
Server validates scoped credential, explicit budget ceiling, expiry, permitted tools and hard timeout; no credential or private host access leaks.
Same-key same-payload retries return the original receipt; same-key changed-payload fails; concurrent and replay tests produce one side effect and one quota decrement.
Verified signed provider event and settled payment map to exactly one canonical order and entitlement; duplicate event delivery creates no duplicate grant.
A bounded authorized job returns schema-valid output and a buyer-retrievable receipt; failure/retry/cancel/refund states are explicit.
Observed fees and direct costs are measured; contribution margin clears the configured floor under the declared workload and failure assumptions.
An independent buyer's settled attributable payment, successful fulfillment, delivery evidence and ledger reconciliation all read back. This is separate from test-mode technical acceptance.
A human explicitly approves any production enablement, public publication, outreach, or spend that falls under an existing approval gate.

Replay the ordered persisted action observations through the existing projection and state transition engine. No EXECUTED state may arise without an explicit ACTION_DISPATCHED event; INTERNAL_ROUTED must never be projected into ACTION_DISPATCHED.
A read-only SELECT and schema/migration inventory succeed after storage/recovery is repaired. Project metadata status alone is not sufficient.
